scientific_question: Does integrating over the frozen generalized-Bayes action-candidate posterior improve held-out predictive distributions or passive execute-versus-fallback decisions relative to selecting its maximum-weight component?

evaluation.posterior_semantics: finite generalized-Bayes model posterior over the 16 frozen action-conditioned ridge and kernel candidates
evaluation.posterior_weight_rule: unchanged frozen generalized_bayes_weights from source leave-one-episode-out objectives
evaluation.map_rule: select the candidate with maximum frozen posterior weight; ties use the existing deterministic candidate order
evaluation.target_component_correction: apply one common source-fitted readout correction to every component and recenter component deviations so their weighted mean equals the exact frozen posterior mean
evaluation.map_self_calibration: fit MAP-specific leave-one-source-episode-out bias and Gaussian variance without target outcomes
evaluation.mixture_calibration: fit one query-specific common conditional variance by deterministic source-only equal-episode mixture-NLL minimization
evaluation.query_bank: reuse byte-identical five-query bank and event semantics from deform360_dependence_query_v6
evaluation.decision_rule: execute the recorded action prediction when posterior adverse-event probability is no greater than the constant fallback cost; otherwise return exact fallback

success_gates.posterior_marginalization_supported: all invariants pass and the posterior mixture has negative mean paired differences with object-bootstrap upper bounds below zero for both NLL and CRPS versus the independently source-calibrated MAP plug-in
success_gates.decision_value_supported: the posterior mixture has object-bootstrap upper bounds below zero for both Brier score and passive decision loss versus the independently source-calibrated MAP plug-in
success_gates.same_mean_distribution_supported: the posterior mixture beats the independently source-calibrated same-mean Gaussian in both NLL and CRPS
success_gates.model_averaging_mean_supported: posterior-mean field RMSE minus independently source-corrected MAP field RMSE has an object-bootstrap upper bound below zero

runner.reason: the complete verified official Deform360 snapshot and exact parent-bound carriers are on gpuserver4090; the gpuserver6000 tree is a noncanonical research working tree

claim_boundary: A positive result would establish retrospective value of generalized-Bayes posterior averaging or marginalization on five registered tactile-field queries over the exact previously scored 92-object Deform360 cohort. It would not establish a physical-parameter posterior, fresh confirmation, unseen-object transfer, Prob4D provider competence, calibrated dense-field uncertainty, strict counterfactual value, active robot improvement, deployment safety, or state of the art.
